$comment: PERF-1 gzip-byte limits per profile and locale, not a combined five-language total. Audit 2026-10-13 against PR90 9fd5b297: maxima JS 194004 B, CSS 19379 B, font 254847 B, image 220730 B, HTML 37175 B (7 pages), initial 181028 B. JS raised 240 -> 250 KiB on 2026-11-17 (Darlington) when B21 generated metadata (#144) and B22 Updates feed (#143) landed together at 241.8-243.9 KiB; raised 250 -> 260 KiB on 2026-11-23 (Darlington) to unblock the preview deploy when CIP-30 wallet (#147) and entity search (#149) landed at 252.6-254.6 KiB, pending a route-scoping pass that should restore 250; it still reserves room for lazy search, Config and survey UI; CSS 24 KiB reserves ~5 KiB for those controls. Initial restored to 180 KiB after route-scoping Prism; new route code must not enter global chrome. Font 280 KiB accommodates the existing fixed families/subsets plus ~12%; image 512 KiB reserves ~296 KiB for optimised diagrams/social art. HTML 8 MiB is a staged ceiling: ~130 pages x 5 retained versions x 10 KiB gzip/page = 6.35 MiB, plus schema/app/retired-route allowance. These are estimates, not a verified completed-site size. Reaudit at B18, B20, B32/B33 and B38; large wallet/search dependencies require measured route-scoped budgets, not automatic cap increases. The deployment raw-size cap and per-page image justification are separate checks. Each HTML file is also capped at 20 KiB gzip independently of its combined initial payload.
